stem: What is the poet most likely suggesting in these lines?
instruction:
Read these lines from the poem.

He sprouted with branches and leaves, and he bloomed! Bartholomew Blue is a tree to this day . . . But at least now he gives off a fragrant bouquet.

options.label: F
options.text: Bartholomew enjoys the scent of trees.

options.label: G
options.text: Bartholomew likes to spend time with nature.

options.label: H
options.text: Bartholomew has decided to wear a tree costume.

options.label: J
options.text: Bartholomew has finally become useful as a tree.
